name: Weave Reel
description: Full-screen WebGL reel of image strips that curve and cross like woven ribbons, moving and bending with page scroll velocity through Lenis infinite scrolling.
contents: Fixed full-viewport three.js canvas with several rotated, curved columns of looping images
behavior: Images loop endlessly along each column
Scroll velocity from Lenis moves each column at its own speed and bends the images through the vertex shader
Lenis runs in infinite mode with touch sync
Direction can be vertical or horizontal
editableByProps: Column layout, rotation, curve and scroll speed
Background color, camera distance, Lenis options, loader
fixed: Canvas is fixed to the full viewport behind page content
Lenis takes over page scrolling in infinite mode when includeLenis is true
Images load from remote URLs and need CORS access
